title: UK first-time buyers in best position to snap up property in a decade, data shows
summary: Halifax says average price of house hit record high of £299,892 in November, after 0% growth Business live – latest updates Buyers attempting to get on to the property ladder in the UK have received a lift, after figures from Halifax showed they are in the best position to snap up a home in a decade. Britain’s biggest mortgage lender said that the average price of a UK property hit a record high of £299,892 in November, after a marginal month-on-month rise. Continue reading...

title: TTC maintenance, asbestos cleanup delaying parts of Rogers’ 5G subway network build
